name: Guanine riboswitch bound to guanine
preparationNotes: GDP (X:14, likely 5' terminal nucleotide artifact) and CCC (X:81, crystallization agent) removed. No Mg ions in structure. Single chain X. Guanine ligand GUN at X:101. Box 22x22x22 A centered on ligand centroid.
source: RCSB PDB 1Y27; Serganov et al. Cell 2004 doi:10.1016/j.cell.2004.11.020
affinitySource: Mandal M & Breaker RR Nat Struct Mol Biol 2004; Kd ~5 uM for guanine
affinityNotes: xpt G-riboswitch from B. subtilis. Guanine Kd ~5 uM. Hypoxanthine (no N2-amino) binds ~10x weaker. Companion to 1Y26 (V. vulnificus adenine riboswitch) — identical fold, single C74U swap confers guanine vs adenine selectivity.
notes: xpt G-riboswitch from B. subtilis. Watson-Crick H-bonds: N1-H to U74 O2, O6 accepts from U74 N3-H. N2-H contacts A52. Stacking sandwich: U47 above, A23 below. 2.40 A X-ray.
